profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
• 10+ years of full stack development experience, designing, implementing and deploying fully tested software solutions.
• Able to design and architect project solutions, implement and style rich UI features, package and deploy project builds to remote servers.
• Advance knowledge of C#, SQL, Javascript, TypeScript, HTML/CSS, Windows/Web Services.
• Generally knowledgeable about SPA libraries and frameworks (Angular, React)
• Generally knowledgeable about Windows Servers, IIS, Amazon Web Services (EC2, RDS, S3), Azure (Elastic Jobs, Blob Storage, Data Factory).
• Generally knowledgeable about web security and encryption.
• Generally knowledgeable about testing methodologies such as TDD and BDD

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Extend and improve MediaRadar’s binary gathering applications, supporting services, and database procedures. Oversee upgrade of internal tools portal frontend, from angular 1.5 to angular 15. Architect series of services across Azure/AWS to consume Large Datasets from 3rd parties (up to 10mil rows/day). Package and deploy release builds to remote servers. Tools used day-to-day: C#, JavaScript, Angular, MongoDB, MSSQL, IIS, Windows Server, Git.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Researched/designed/developed new features across all tiers for Infragistics' ReportPlus Server, an enterprise-level server application designed for storing, viewing and sharing business analytics. Migrate application front-end from JavaScript & JQuery to Angular & TypeScript front-end. Implement OAuth based data-sources. Add recent and favorite dashboard cross-platform sync functionality. Package and deploy release build to remote servers. Tools used day-to-day: Windows Server, IIS, MSSQL Server, ASP.NET MVC, C#, Angular, TypeScript, Node and WebPack.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed/maintained/deployed digital marketing SaaS platform hosted in AWS EC2 instance. Upgraded and maintained support systems and APIs. Led overhaul of MVC application for Wix marketplace. Tools used day-to-day: Windows Server, IIS, MySql, ASP.NET MVC, C#, JavaScript.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Supported, maintained, and extended, Expense System, PTO Application, Formula Inventory Tracking and Labeling, ERP system built on proprietary DML, SSRS Reports and other internal business applications. Tools used day-to-day: Windows Server, IIS, Oracle11g/MS SQL Server 2008 R2, ASP.NET MVC, Windows Forms, C#,  JavaScript.
